descriptive_qas.question: What is the blue ball on the floor doing during this segment, and where is it moving relative to the white platform with the yellow ball on top?
choices: A) rolling steadily along the floor toward the right-side red dominoes instead of toward the central white platform
B) rolling steadily to the left, passing in front of the central white platform toward the left-side dominoes
C) remaining nearly stationary on the floor beside the platform while the yellow ball on top does the moving
D) rolling steadily along the floor toward the central white platform that has another ball resting on top of it

descriptive_qas.question: In the right-side red domino row, what contact happens during this segment, and what does the blue floor ball hit?
choices: A) the floor ball collides directly with a domino in the row, without first knocking the platform over into it
B) the floor ball first knocks the platform over, and the falling platform then hits the domino row
C) the floor ball misses the domino row entirely and rolls past it without making contact
D) the floor ball collides directly with the yellow ball on the platform, instead of striking any domino

descriptive_qas.question: What are the dominoes on the right side near the platform and blue ball doing during this segment, and in what pattern?
choices: A) the closest domino is knocked over and falls into its neighbor, which then tips the next one, propagating a chain reaction along the row
B) the first domino is struck and slides away from the row, so the motion stops instead of tipping the next one
C) the nearest domino stays upright while the blue ball rolls past it, leaving the rest of the row untouched
D) the far domino falls first and knocks backward into the ones behind it, sending the chain reaction in the opposite direction

causal_qas.question: Why does the first domino in the right-side red row begin to fall during this segment?
choices: A) the first red domino tipped on its own after being jostled by a neighboring black domino falling from behind
B) the yellow ball rolled off the raised platform and clipped the first red domino, knocking it into the row
C) the rolling floor ball reached the row and struck a domino directly, transferring its momentum into that standing piece
D) the blue ball slid past the row without contact, and the front red domino fell because the floor beneath it shifted

causal_qas.question: Why are the black-and-red dominoes on the right side falling one after another during this segment?
choices: A) the blue floor ball is pushing through the row right now, knocking each domino over itself instead of a prior first strike
B) the yellow ball on the table has just rolled off and directly hit the middle dominoes, causing the rest to topple outward
C) the black dominoes behind the row fell first from the far end, and their impact is now spreading backward through the red pieces
D) the rolling floor ball had earlier struck the first domino directly, and that fall is now tipping each successive piece along the row
